walkthrough.area: Time off calendar grid vs. header window, roles admin/manager/user
walkthrough.observed: Stepping the window with the prior/next controls moves both the range label and the day-header columns together for admin, manager and user sessions. Selecting the Teams scope with nothing ticked clears calendar-grid entirely, leaving only calendar-error-banner, and stepping the window while the refusal stands moves the label with the grid still absent. Delaying the calendar fetch shows the loading skeleton (no calendar-day-header-* cells) while the label has already advanced, then the grid replaces the skeleton with the new window's days once the delayed response resolves. Returning to the All scope restores the grid.
walkthrough.result: matches the fix approach and REQ-01-049
